Ask a hard question, get a page you can actually read instead of a wall of text.

Turn the sound on for the music."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Why not just ask for HTML?"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"You can. Models write decent HTML now. But most of what they write is not content. We counted the to"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"kens in 9 pages the model wrote by hand, 4,893 tokens on average:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Part of the page | Share | With this skill |
| :--- | ---: | :--- |
| SVG diagrams: coordinates an"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"d paths | 47% | The CLI writes it |
| CSS | 15% | The CLI writes it |
| HTML tags | 17% | The CLI wr"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ites it |
| Text | 21% | The model writes it, as Markdown |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"With this skill the model writes only a Markdown draft. For the same questions that was 612 tokens o"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"n average, **about 1/8 of the hand-written HTML**. Less to write means less to wait for (3 topics × "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"3 runs, medians, Claude Sonnet 5.5, a plain Claude Code setup):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| | Ask for HTML directly | Answer me with HTML | |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | :--- |
| Tokens the model"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" writes | 4,893 | **612** | **8× fewer** |
| Time | 31 s | **12 s** | **2.6× faster** |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The same question, the same model, answered both ways. Both pages are usable."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The token counts are saved in bench/corpus/tokens.json, so `node bench/corpus.mjs` gives the same nu"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"mbers every time. The pages themselves are a download. The bill drops less than the writing, about 1"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"5% here, because every turn also reads the system prompt, your question and the conversation, with o"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"r without the skill. See where the cost goes."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Explainer videos save even more: about 18× fewer output tokens and 12× faster in a small test."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"You need Node.js 20 or newer. There is no `npm install` step. The CLI is bundled inside the skill. N"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"o Node.js yet? With the recommended install below, your agent asks you and then installs it."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Let your agent install it (recommended)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode or any other agent:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"> Install Answer me with HTML: read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html/m"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ain/INSTALL.md and follow it."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Claude Code plugin"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Run this inside Claude Code:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## What you ask, what you get"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| You ask | You get |
| :--- | :--- |
| "Explain the TCP three-way handshake" | A sequence diagram, "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"a state diagram and a flag table |
| "How are the modules in this repo organized?" | A folder tree p"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"lus a call graph |
| "Redis or Memcached?" | A comparison table with ✓ and ✗, then a verdict |
| "Wh"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"at's wrong with this paragraph?" | Each sentence annotated, with the problem words and fixes |
| "Ho"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"w did Kubernetes come about?" | A timeline with the key moments highlighted |
| "Plan the cache chan"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"ge" | The real code from your files, and the open decisions as options you answer on the page |
| "H"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"ow do I show hidden files with `ls`?" | No page. A one-line question gets a one-line answer |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The agent decides when a page is worth it: related concepts, multi-step flows, multi-way comparisons"},{"id":"p30s2","text":". You can also just say "explain it in HTML"."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Pages are saved in `~/.answer-me-with-html/pages/`. The buttons in the top-right corner switch the t"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"heme and light/dark mode, collect your reply, and copy the Markdown that produced the page."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"This is all the model writes:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]
sequence num
Client -> Server: SYN, seq=x
Server -> Client: SYN+ACK, seq=y, ack=x+1
Cli"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"ent -> Server: ACK, ack=y+1
note Client, Server: ESTABLISHED"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]
flow LR
(CLOSED) -> LISTEN: passive open
LISTEN -> SYN_RCVD: get SYN / send SYN+ACK
SYN"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"_RCVD -> *ESTABLISHED: get ACK"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]
`"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"The CLI does the rest. It picks the template, places the panels, applies the theme, lays out the flo"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"w chart with dagre and spaces the sequence diagram by label width. The full draft, examples/tcp.en.m"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"d, becomes this page:"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- **Layout by code:** Panel placement and diagram coordinates are computed, not guessed. Labels don'"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"t get cut off, and there are no gaps in the grid.
- **Fixes its own mistakes:** When a draft has an "},{"id":"p39s3","text":"error, the CLI returns the line number, the component and a correct example. The agent fixes it in o"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"ne try.
- **Three themes:** `blueprint` looks like an engineering drawing, `shadcn` uses clean cards"},{"id":"p39s5","text":", and `paper` is set for long reading. By default the CLI picks paper for long text and blueprint fo"},{"id":"p39s6","text":"r diagrams. All have light and dark modes, and you can add your own or take one from the theme catal"},{"id":"p39s7","text":"og.
- **One file, no dependencies:** Each page is a single `.html` with no CDN links or web fonts. I"},{"id":"p39s8","text":"t opens offline and is easy to share.
- **Languages:** Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), English"},{"id":"p39s9","text":" and Japanese get their own buttons and fonts. Other languages work with English buttons. See langua"},{"id":"p39s10","text":"ges.
- **Writing check:** Drafts are checked against rules adapted from ASD-STE100: long sentences, "},{"id":"p39s11","text":"wordy phrases, passive voice. It only warns unless you ask for strict mode.
- **Real code, not retyp"},{"id":"p39s12","text":"ed:** A code block can quote lines from your files (`src=` `lines=`), so the code on the page is the"},{"id":"p39s13","text":" real code. Files outside the folder and files that hold keys are refused.
- **Answer on the page:**"},{"id":"p39s14","text":" Comment on any panel, and pick options in the decisions the agent asks (`ask`). The Reply button tu"},{"id":"p39s15","text":"rns your answers and comments into one message to paste back to the agent.
- **Keeps its source:** E"},{"id":"p39s16","text":"very page embeds the Markdown that made it. Click "Copy source" to get it back."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Blueprint theme (examples/ste100.md)
